module.Title: Examine Every Reading
module.Teaching: A for loop can visit every value in a list without manually using indexes.
module.PredictionQuestion: What does temperature represent inside the loop?
module.PredictionExplanation: The loop variable receives one list element at a time.
module.DebugPrompt: The iterable and loop variable are reversed.
module.RecallPrompt: Loop through and print each temperature. Use the exact identifier temperatures.
module.TransferPrompt: Loop through and print each pressure. Use the exact identifier pressures.
module.PreviewMessage: Every stored sensor reading can now be inspected.
